From 32f37e57583f869140cff445feedeea8a5fea986 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzysztof.kozlowski@oss.qualcomm.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jan 2026 08:21:40 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] serial: Fix not set tty->port race condition

Revert commit bfc467db60b7 ("serial: remove redundant
tty_port_link_device()") because the tty_port_link_device() is not
redundant: the tty->port has to be confured before we call
uart_configure_port(), otherwise user-space can open console without TTY
linked to the driver.

This tty_port_link_device() was added explicitly to avoid this exact
issue in commit fb2b90014d78 ("tty: link tty and port before configuring
it as console"), so offending commit basically reverted the fix saying
it is redundant without addressing the actual race condition presented
there.

Reproducible always as tty->port warning on Qualcomm SoC with most of
devices disabled, so with very fast boot, and one serial device being
the console:

  printk: legacy console [ttyMSM0] enabled
  printk: legacy console [ttyMSM0] enabled
  printk: legacy bootconsole [qcom_geni0] disabled
  printk: legacy bootconsole [qcom_geni0] disabled
  
diff --git a/drivers/tty/serial/serial_core.c b/drivers/tty/serial/serial_core.c
index 9930023e924c..2805cad10511 100644
--- a/drivers/tty/serial/serial_core.c
+++ b/drivers/tty/serial/serial_core.c
@@ -3074,6 +3074,12 @@ static int serial_core_add_one_port(struct uart_driver *drv, struct uart_port *u
 	if (uport->cons && uport->dev)
 		of_console_check(uport->dev->of_node, uport->cons->name, uport->line);
 
+	/*
+	 * TTY port has to be linked with the driver before register_console()
+	 * in uart_configure_port(), because user-space could open the console
+	 * immediately after.
+	 */
+	tty_port_link_device(port, drv->tty_driver, uport->line);
 	uart_configure_port(drv, state, uport);
 
 	port->console = uart_console(uport);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch introduces a single modification to `drivers/tty/serial/serial_core.c`:

- **Modification**: A call to `tty_port_link_device(port, drv->tty_driver, uport->line)` is added **before** the `uart_configure_port()` invocation in the `serial_core_add_one_port()` function.

- **Relationship**: The added line ensures that the TTY port is linked with the TTY driver (setting `tty->port`) **prior** to configuring the console via `uart_configure_port()`. This prevents a race condition where user-space could open the console device immediately after `register_console()` (called inside `uart_configure_port()`) before the TTY–port association is established, which previously caused a missing `tty->port` warning on Qualcomm SoCs with fast boot. The patch effectively reverts the logic of commit `bfc467db60b7` (which had removed this call) and restores the fix from `fb2b90014d78`.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
<text>uart_configure_port(drv, state, uport);</text>
Reason:
<text>Without a prior call to tty_port_link_device(), the TTY port is not linked to the driver in the driver->ports[] array. uart_configure_port() calls register_console(), making the console available to user-space. User-space can then open the console before tty_port_link_device() is called (which was originally done later or removed), resulting in tty->port being NULL and triggering a kernel warning.</text>
The code statements that fix the bug are:
<text>tty_port_link_device(port, drv->tty_driver, uport->line);
uart_configure_port(drv, state, uport);</text>
Reason:
<text>Adding tty_port_link_device() before uart_configure_port() ensures the TTY port is correctly linked to the driver's port table before the console is registered. This prevents the race condition by guaranteeing that tty->port is set when user-space opens the console.</text>

Root cause:
The commit `bfc467db60b7` removed the `tty_port_link_device()` call from `serial_core_add_one_port()`, assuming it was redundant. However, this call was necessary to link the TTY port with the driver before `uart_configure_port()` registers the console. Without it, user-space could open the console device immediately after registration, before `tty->port` is set, causing a race condition and a kernel warning on fast boot.
